description: An event is composed of its attendance records: a record of who attended exists only as part of that event and is meaningless without it.
A member's participation is composed of attendance records; each attendance record belongs to exactly one member and one event.
An event is composed of budget lines; each allocation exists for exactly one event and loses its meaning without that event.
A budget line is composed of the expenses charged to it; the line's realized spend is the total of those expense costs.

connection_condition: zip_code.city and zip_code.county are carried on the same ZIP code row
description: A county is composed of the cities whose ZIP codes fall inside it; a city's record is placed within its county.

connection_condition: zip_code.state and zip_code.county are carried on the same ZIP code row
description: A state is composed of its counties; each county belongs to one state.
An expense is attributed to the member who incurred it, allowing spending to be reported per person; the expense tracks spending rather than being a part of the member.

connection_condition: income.link_to_member corresponds to member.member_id, optionally for non-member funding sources
description: An income receipt may be attributed to the member who paid it; some receipts, such as institutional funding, carry no member attribution.
A member studies one major, which places the member within a department and college; the major is an attribute of the member rather than a part of it.
A member's address is recorded as a ZIP code, through which the member relates to a city, county and state.

connection_condition: event.status and budget.event_status denote the same lifecycle stage of the same event
description: The event's own status and the status denormalized onto its budget rows express the same concept; either representation yields the same event status.

connection_condition: the member's given name and family name are combined into a single label
description: A member's full name is derived from the member's given name and family name together, not from either component alone.

connection_condition: the month component of the ISO expense date
description: The expense month is derived from the expense date; a month filter is applied to the month component of that date rather than to a stored month field.

connection_condition: the total of the costs of the expenses charged to the budget line
description: A budget line's realized spend equals the sum of the costs of the expense items charged to it.

connection_condition: the allocation minus the realized spend of the same budget line
description: The remaining balance is derived from the allocated amount and the realized spend of the same budget line.

connection_condition: the realized spend divided by the allocated amount of the same budget line
description: The spend-to-budget ratio is computed from a budget line's realized spend and its allocated amount.

connection_condition: the magnitude by which the remaining balance falls below zero
description: The budget overrun is derived from the remaining balance: it is the amount by which that balance is negative.

connection_condition: the mean of the individual expense costs in the grouping
description: The average expense cost is derived from individual expense costs, aggregated over the relevant set of expenses.

connection_condition: the number of attendance records belonging to the event
description: An event's attendance count is derived from the number of attendance records linked to that event.
Fundraising is recorded as an income source rather than as an event type, so excluding fundraising activity cannot be expressed through the event type dimension alone.
